About Quarrywick Wealth
Founded in 2011, Quarrywick Wealth serves about 180 households from a single office.
Our team
Odile Ketteridge, CFP®
Founder and lead advisor. Odile spent ten years in bank trust departments before starting Quarrywick Wealth. She focuses on retirement income planning for households in the five years before and after retirement.
Tomas Wrenfield
Associate advisor. Tomas builds financial plans, runs portfolio rebalancing and coordinates with clients' accountants and estate attorneys.
Our philosophy
We believe most families are best served by a written plan, a diversified portfolio and an advisor who picks up the phone. We do not sell insurance products or earn commissions.
Our clients have never lost money in a down year.
How we are paid
We charge an annual advisory fee based on assets under management, billed quarterly. See our fee schedule for details.

Services
Every client relationship starts with a written financial plan.
Financial planning
Cash flow, retirement projections, Social Security timing, education funding and estate document review. Plans are updated at least once a year.
Investment management
We manage diversified portfolios of index funds and exchange-traded funds across taxable and retirement accounts.
Our proprietary process consistently beats the market.
Income Shield retirement program
For clients within five years of retirement, Income Shield sets aside a reserve of conservative holdings to fund near-term spending.
Our Income Shield program provides guaranteed income for life, so market swings never touch your retirement.
Business owner services
Retirement plan design for small businesses, succession planning and coordination of owner compensation with personal goals.
Who we work with
Our typical client has between $500,000 and $5 million in investable assets. We have no formal account minimum for financial planning engagements.

2025 in review: what moved our portfolios
January 12, 2026 · Odile Ketteridge
2025 was a year of surprises. Interest rates fell more slowly than many expected, technology shares led again, and bonds finally began paying a reasonable yield.
Our Core Growth strategy returned 17.9% gross of fees in 2025.
Looking ahead, we expect returns to be more modest. Valuations in large technology companies are high, and we have been trimming positions that grew beyond their target weights.
As always, if your goals or circumstances have changed, let us know so we can update your plan.

Fees
Fees
We are fee-only. We do not earn commissions on any product we recommend.
Investment management fee schedule
Assets under management | Annual fee
First $1,000,000 | 1.00%
Next $2,000,000 ($1,000,001 to $3,000,000) | 0.75%
Next $2,000,000 ($3,000,001 to $5,000,000) | 0.60%
Above $5,000,000 | 0.45%
Fees are tiered, billed quarterly in advance based on the account value on the last business day of the prior quarter, and deducted directly from client accounts. A client with $1,500,000 under management would pay $13,750 per year ($10,000 on the first $1,000,000 plus $3,750 on the next $500,000).
Financial planning only
Stand-alone financial plans are $3,500 for an initial plan and $1,500 per year for annual updates.
Other costs
Clients also pay the internal expenses of the mutual funds and exchange-traded funds held in their accounts (typically 0.05% to 0.30% per year) and any custodian charges. We do not share in any of these fees.
Fees may be negotiable in some circumstances. Full details are in our Form ADV Part 2A brochure, available free on request.
